headline: Fort Lewis and UCCS share the scoring lead
dek: UCCS's draw at home to Midwestern State was the first time they had conceded this season, and it left them level with Fort Lewis on twelve goals. Neither side has lost a match.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The gap between the top and the bottom of the chart is still wide: Colorado Mesa, Colorado School of Mines, Regis and Adams State have scored fewer goals together than Fort Lewis have alone.

wire.line: Adams State have lost all three of their matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Westminster's win over Jamestown was their first of the season after three draws, and they remain unbeaten.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: CSU Pueblo conceded for the first time this season against Newman, and have won all three of their matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: No match is a score gap today, but twelve have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Sjöberg's twelve saves for UCCS have come at the cost of a single goal.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado Mesa have drawn three matches and lost one, and are still without a win.

last_match.line: Westminster's unbeaten start finally includes a win; Jamestown had already drawn with Colorado Mesa and South Dakota Mines.

next_match.line: Lubbock Christian have already lost to Fort Lewis and MSU Denver and beaten Adams State; UCCS have yet to lose.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
